basic_info.description: Well maintained classic Edwardian flats in a great central Richmond location. Each unit is a spacious 2 bedroom plus sunroom and a split bath. Formal dining room and eat-in kitchen. Lower flat tastefully updated and has in unit washer/dryer. Upper unit ready for a transformation into the home of your dreams. There is an unwarranted 1 bedroom 1 bath on the ground floor. Large garage with 2 car tandem parking. Walk to Golden Gate Park, shopping, dining and public transportation. Less than one block from the highly rated Argonne Elementary School. Walk Score 86 Transit Score 71 Bike Score 78
